name: Sweet Chili Salmon Sandwich with Avocado & Ginger-Tahini Dressed Salad

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, sugar, water, chili-garlic sauce, and salt in a small saucepan; whisk to combine. Set over medium-high heat and bring to a boil, whisking occasionally.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup rice vinegar
¼ cup brown sugar
3 tbsp water
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, in a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth.

Once the sauce is boiling, add cornstarch slurry to the pan in a steady stream while whisking quickly. Cook, whisking constantly, until the sweet chili sauce thickens, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat, cover, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat salmon dry with paper towels and place skin-side down on a plate; season the top side with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg salmon fillet
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add salmon, skin-side down, and cook, flipping once, until skin is crispy and flesh is opaque, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ avocados
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger; place in a large bowl. Add tahini, vinegar, soy sauce, oil, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup tahini
¼ cup rice vinegar
¼ cup soy sauce
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and thinly slice. Add to the plate with the salmon.
Separate lettuce leaves; set aside two leaves per sandwich. Chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces, then add to the bowl with the dressing and veggies. Toss to combine the salad.
Place the bottom half of a bun on each plate. Top with salmon, sweet chili sauce, avocado, and reserved lettuce leaves; close with the top half of each bun. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
